admission_reason: Connected initial material and observed full loading/rebound define phase. Only pre-collapse frames meeting65% coverage are supervised; all lower-coverage frames and ambiguous identities masked. Full-collapse behavior remains unsupported; phase is not renormalized to the truncated supervision interval.

annotation.method: Median row intensity over central width; top bright-material front requires three consecutive rows above max(20,40% band maximum), lower liner is local row-intensity maximum. Median-filter21frames. Start=first50frame run at least2px below initial100frame median height; end=last minimum-height plateau frame before>=2px visible rebound. Initial row search bands and endpoint contact sheets visually reviewed.
annotation.limitations: Retrospective image-only phase convention, not load, strain, physical timestamp calibration, or original author annotation. Onset carries pixel/threshold uncertainty; max-compression plateau end is defined operationally.

sampling: Every10th raw loading-window frame plus exact endpoints; original frame indices retained.
mask_policy: Original unambiguous gated node matches AND at least65% initial-node coverage. Endpoint below gate remains all-false; no imputation.
split_policy: Exploratory fit-only augmentation with fixed original5specimen held-out benchmark; physical lineage cannot overlaptest/validation.
